narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On August 8, 2024, at approximately 0705 hours, Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a gas station in Saginaw, Michigan, during a follow-up investigation. Agent [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] identified himself and asked the subject about his citizenship.
The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and has no immigration documents. He presented a Mexican consular identification card. The subject stated that he last entered the United States in May 2019 by crossing the Rio Grande on foot near Del Rio, Texas, without being inspected.
TRAVEL:
He stated that he was picked up near Del Rio and driven to San Antonio, and later travelled to Michigan by bus.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
The subject was processed for a Notice to Appear and detained at the [REDACTED (b)(7)(E)] Station.
